name: open-meeting-agent
description: A local agent that joins your meetings, answers when called, and turns the call into a plan delivered where your team works and executed by your coding agent — as an MCP server and a Claude Code plugin.

scripts.build:
esbuild src/cli.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node22 --outfile=dist/oma.mjs --banner:js="#!/usr/bin/env node
import { createRequire as __cr } from 'node:module'; const require = __cr(import.meta.url);" --legal-comments=none
scripts.test: npm run build && node --no-warnings --test --import tsx test/*.test.ts
